evidence_status: Usable sex-by-BMI mean/SE constraints with assumption-dependent continuous interpolation.
consequence: Category averages do not determine pointwise effects; transporting them can shift means and slopes.
next_action: Source-check arithmetic summaries, avoid stacking adjusted BMI coefficients, review any source-calibration mismatch.
resolution: Extracted exact sex-by-BMI means and SEs and selected interpolated mean/SD model; exact integrated source cell means remain unidentified.

affected_analysis: Nonlinearity, severe-obesity contrasts and BMI tail analyses
evidence_status: Only an open obesity category and qualitative cross-population monotonic/linear context; severe-BMI slope missing.
consequence: Flat versus continuing decline above BMI 30 can materially alter interpretation at BMI 40-70.
next_action: Compare the selected exponential decline with flat continuation on invented BMI inputs; seek source severe-BMI stratification if review identifies an attainable lead.
resolution: Focused sensitivity executed; retained explicit declining extrapolation provisionally rather than infer a zero slope from a missing subdivision.

affected_analysis: Age association, age-by-sex interaction and older-adult contrasts
evidence_status: Small common adjusted Taiwan age contrasts; Dallas standardized age coefficient differs by sex; compatible raw slope not available.
consequence: Common age effect may understate sex-specific patterns; 20-29 and 71-79 require extrapolation.
next_action: Reserve retrieval budget for age-sex effects or source SDs under compatible adjustment following review.
resolution: Common modest age curve is provisional; no conversion of standardized beta to mg/dL/year.

affected_analysis: Correlations, subgroup spread, low-HDL prevalence and confidence intervals
evidence_status: Cell SE and n yield total cell SD, not exact residual SD conditional on continuous BMI and age.
consequence: Conditional spread may be overestimated by retained within-cell predictor variance or underestimated by transport differences.
next_action: Verify SE conversion; test model moments on invented repeated inputs; revisit if residual evidence obtained.
resolution: Used source-cell SD proxy with no unwarranted residual deduction; source-specific marginal quantiles cannot calibrate conditional variance.

affected_analysis: Threshold prevalence and extreme HDL quantiles
evidence_status: Mean/SE and marginal U.S. IQR do not identify conditional distribution family.
consequence: Lognormal family fixes skew and tail probabilities absent direct evidence.
next_action: Retain positive lognormal as explicit assumption; do not interpret tail fit as validated.
resolution: Positivity and stochasticity verified. Conditional tail probabilities remain assumption-sensitive.

next_action: Keep selection/assay bridges explicit and use independent U.S. context for review; no survey-wide target calibration.
resolution: Added Dallas context and UK/Malawi transport evidence; no numerical offset inferred from unmatched marginal summaries.
